context: First post-WrestleMania 42 PLE; corrective-card stress test — does the WM42 medicine hold?

segments.outcome: Roman Reigns retains the World Heavyweight Championship via contested finish; outside interference (Usos and/or Solo Sikoa) prevents a clean resolution. Fatu exits more dangerous than he entered.
segments.notes: Predicted dirty retention — ritual reads this as too large for a B-PLE; seeds Roman vs. Fatu for WM43. Usos enforce the family code (Death Grip violation) rather than loyalty to either man. Solo is the chaos variable from the margins. Medium confidence — line movement from -3000 to -700 signals possible Fatu acceleration if Roman is leaving TV.

segments.outcome: Bron Breakker defeats Seth Rollins clean (or near-clean). Breakker earns his credential as Heyman's institutional weapon. Rollins loses as the lone wolf without coalition support.
segments.notes: Predicted Breakker win — Loki founds the monster by losing to it. WM42 debt to Rollins paid in narrative currency (meaningful loss) rather than a corrective W. Steel-stairs grammar from go-home Raw (Bron → Seth Seg 1, Seth → Bron Seg 9) resolved at Backlash. Rollins's refusal to join the multi-front coalition costs him here. Medium-High confidence; -130 Bron at book.

segments.outcome: IYO Sky defeats Asuka clean. The Kabuki Warriors paired-apparition structure is formally dissolved; both women are now operating as solo entities.
segments.notes: Predicted IYO win — Queen answers the Onryō. WM41 triple-threat coronation is validated, not cheapened. Kairi Sane appearance possible (F4W >50%) but IYO wins regardless. -400 favorite; mythology and money align. Kabuki Warriors thread transforms from paired-faction to individual arcs for each woman.

segments.outcome: Danhausen and mystery partner defeat The Miz and Kit Wilson. Mystery partner (betting favorite CM Punk at -200, Joe Hendry at +200) provides the pop moment. Danhausen's team wins.
segments.notes: Predicted Danhausen team win — Scroll 005 live, transparency-potency principle at PLE scale. Sacred Clown's function is to prove the pharmacy works in daylight; a loss collapses the thesis. Mystery partner is the real payload; the match is the vehicle. Very High confidence (-5000 equivalent). If CM Punk: Prometheus meets Heyoka. If Hendry: Orphic Bard meets Sacred Clown. Either pairing is pharmacologically significant.

segments.outcome: John Cena makes a 'history-making announcement' — framed around Club WWE or a subscription/institutional product. Non-wrestling appearance; Cena acts as structural/promotional element rather than performer.
segments.notes: Retired Champion as institutional avatar — the archetype converts from vessel to pharmacy plumbing (recurring revenue mythology). Watch crowd reception: tribute vs. extraction. TKO boo at WM42 is the precedent. Cody vs. Gunther (Undisputed WWE Championship) was pulled from this card and deferred to Clash in Italy, May 31, Turin.
